newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE firms in quiet trade, little news.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE firms in quiet trade, little news.

text.p: Prompt U.S. MTBE firmed on Friday in quiet trade that saw a few deals done as buyers continued to compete for scant supplies, players said.
There was little fundamental news Friday apart from news early this morning that the startup of Superoctanos' 12,500 bpd plant in Venezuela was delayed due to a power failure.
Prompt MTBE in the U.S. Gulf was done at 97.00 cents a gallon, putting sellers at 97.50 cents. Any month August was pegged 95.00/95.50 cents, with first half of the month 97.50/98.00 cents.
In New York Harbor, spot MTBE was heard done at 103.00 cents, about a half cent above Thursday values.
